rubric.evidence: Fresh-Chromium verify-first probe (/tmp/webai-g7-glm-text2-probe.mjs) dynamic-imported @huggingface/transformers@3.7.5 from jsDelivr, created pipeline('feature-extraction','Xenova/all-mpnet-base-v2',{device:'wasm',dtype:'q8',revision:'e086c5e0b3a57b0ce46dd6d9c0662948860b35f3'}), downloaded onnx/model_quantized.onnx (110,086,122 bytes), and completed real batch inference: 768-d output, related cosine 0.5634 vs unrelated 0.0014. Load 21.6s, inference 128ms. Committed route-complete validator repeats inference on all five routes at desktop+mobile (45/45 pass).

feature-extraction with pooling:'mean', normalize:false returns per-text 768-d token-mean vectors; worker L2-normalizes so cosine is a dot product. Overview validator confirmed #rDim==='768', 96 vec-cells in See-inside, pre-norm ‖v‖=3.116>0. Wild route produced king−man+woman ≈ queen (textbook-correct analogy), confirming the geometry is genuinely semantic.

At-a-glance declares canonical sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 + browser mirror Xenova/all-mpnet-base-v2 pinned to revision e086c5e (immutable, no floating 'main'), task sentence-similarity, MPNet architecture, q8 / WASM, ~105 MB, Apache-2.0. Worker loads the exact pinned revision; the central loader disables update-discovery for the pinned key.

Every route loads via lib/model-loader.js createModelLoader with a revision-extended cache key; a fresh profile shows a Download button and never auto-downloads the absent model (validator confirms 'fresh profile exposes Download'). Returning users with a validated cached copy auto-init (checking→initialising→ready). Clear-cached-model + Release-from-memory controls are real.

Loading/progress/ready/error states surface in role=status aria-live=polite regions and the shared <model-download-status> panel; Retry on failure; Clear cached model + Release from memory available once ready. Validator drove the Download→ready→run path on every route with zero console errors and zero failed network requests.

All controls real + labelled + keyboard-operable: Compare/Search/Cluster/Classify/Solve buttons, sentence/passage/label/vocab textareas, analogy chips, k sliders, query inputs. Enter submits search. Buttons expose accessible names; no dead/decorative controls.

Every numeric output is produced by a real worker inference bound to the model loader; no hardcoded scores. Validator requires live DOM results (#ranked≥2, #score finite>0.4, clusters≥2, analogy top answer) after a genuine Download+run.

Semantic headings/tables, labelled form controls, role=status aria-live regions, the similarity matrix uses scope=col/row + title tooltips, the PCA SVG has role=img + aria-label. Conformance asserts buttons-have-names and images-have-alt (no content images on these pages).

Layout uses auto-fit minmax(300px,1fr) grid + overflow-x:auto matrix scroll; validator confirmed no horizontal overflow at desktop 1280×800 AND mobile 360×740 DPR3 on all five routes. support field left 'needs-review' pending parent visual inspection (worker has no vision capability).

All inference runs in a module Web Worker (off the main thread); PCA runs over only a handful of vectors on the main thread (cheap). break-up-long-tasks guidance satisfied by worker offloading — the dense 768-d math never blocks the UI.

guidanceConsulted.query: off-main-thread text model worker pipeline with model loader progress error retry and responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep heavy synchronous computation off the main thread; inference in a Web Worker so input/repaint stay responsive.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — all feature-extraction inference runs in models/all-mpnet-base-v2/worker.js (a module Web Worker); the page only does cheap PCA over a few vectors and DOM rendering.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status progress download and responsive grid control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML, labelled controls, visible focus, and polite live regions for status; do not rely on colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — native labelled form controls, role=status aria-live=polite status/download regions, scope headers + title tooltips on the matrix, role=img+aria-label on the PCA chart, readable text scores alongside colour.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use modern intrinsic sizing (auto-fit/minmax grid, flex) for responsive layouts that reflow without fixed widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — .grid-2 uses grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr)); .matrix-scroll uses overflow-x:auto; validator confirms no horizontal overflow at both viewports.

Consider a cross-encoder-vs-bi-encoder latency/precision comparison table on the Multi-model route.
summary: all-mpnet-base-v2 is the sentence-transformers reference-quality English sentence embedding (MPNet, 768-d, Apache-2.0), built from the browser-ready Xenova q8 ONNX mirror pinned to an immutable revision. Distinct from every built embedder (no MPNet architecture existed). Five routes all run real off-thread inference; verify-first probe + route-complete validator (45/45, 10/10) confirm genuine semantic geometry (king−man+woman≈queen, related≫unrelated cosine). Visual support left needs-review for parent inspection.
